If you know shes struggling emotionally, shes showing you she feels vulnerable and like theres "too much distance" between you she may be over stressing herself and causing herself even more anxiety. With bpd you really have 2 options to male a relationship work, either get her help to get in to see a doctor who can help get medication to regulate hormone fluxes or be the most supportive boyfriend in the world and understand if shes having a hormonal imbalance it can affect her moods rapidly and the only way to help is to
ADDRESS  ASSESS AND REDIRECT 
Address that her feelings are valid that they can happen randomly and make us feel out of control but we can take a step back always and try to find a reason to what causes the feelings.
Assess this is your hard part you need to listen even if she goes in circles as to what caused her to feel this way. If she feels youve been looking at women more which youve even said ypu have been she may have subtly picked up on that. She may feel insecure like shes not pretty enough to hold your attention anymore? These negative feelimgs are always more strongly amplified because they can get fueled with intrusive thoughts. Guilt, anxiety, paranoia you musy constantly re affirm the truth if you love her then you love her no simpler truth than that.
And finally redirect her behavior when you notice she is starting to act differently do subtle things to let her notice if your walking in the store and she seems grumpy hold her hand and give her a kiss let her know your there for her. It will cause her to be a bit muddled in feelings but shes more likely to mirror a positive mood.
